relationships.subject: TMEM251

relationships.subject: BMAL1

key_findings: Narrative review of ACC neuroplasticity in neuropathic pain: GluN2B-dependent LTP and BDNF-TrkB dendritic remodeling, glial mechanisms and neuromodulation.
BDNF-TrkB signaling facilitates GluN2B trafficking; TMEM251 loss impairs autophagy in ACC and drives chronic pain-like behavior.
